title: Call 1: The 10-Minute Audit
notes: Call 1 consultative discovery and clinical diagnosis. Sentence-level lines with Alex Hormozi vocal cues.

lines.label: Good to meet & carve time
lines.raw: [Name], good to meet you [⬇️]. [⏸️] Appreciate you carving out 10 minutes [⬇️].

lines.label: Not here to pitch
lines.raw: [🐢] Just to set the stage so we use our time well—I'm not here to pitch you anything today [⬇️].

lines.label: Where AI makes sense
lines.raw: [⏸️] Every firm runs their day-to-day differently, so I don't even know where AI makes the most sense for you yet [⬇️].

lines.label: Walk me through operations
lines.raw: [⚡] What I'd love to do for the next 8 minutes is just have you walk me through how your whole firm operates right now [⬇️].

lines.label: Front to backend admin
lines.raw: From how clients find you, to how you handle calls and quotes, to the backend admin [⬇️].

lines.label: Custom preview promise
lines.raw: [⏸️] [🐢] If I see a clear way we can save you hours every week or add revenue, I'll map out a custom plan and build a working preview for you to see next time [⬇️].

lines.label: Sound fair
lines.raw: If I don't see a massive return for you, I'll tell you straight and we'll part ways [⬇️]. [⏸️] Sound fair [🤔]?

lines.label: Bucket 1: Bird's eye focus
lines.raw: To start from a bird's-eye view—I saw on your site that you guys focus on [mention 1 specific thing from their website] [⬇️].

lines.label: Bucket 1: Firm structure
lines.raw: [⏸️] Walk me through how the firm is structured right now [⬇️].

lines.label: Bucket 1: Team & typical day
lines.raw: How many people are on the team, and what does a typical day look like for you personally [🤔]?

lines.label: Bucket 1: Personal time drain
lines.raw: [🤔] Got it... and out of everything you're doing day-to-day, what's eating up the most of your personal time right now?

lines.label: Bucket 2: Front end lead gen
lines.raw: Okay, let's look at the front end [⬇️]. How are new [listings / remodeling projects] coming in right now [🤔]? Is it mostly word-of-mouth, or are you running your own campaigns?

lines.label: Bucket 2: Dormant photos
lines.raw: [🐢] Makes sense [⬇️]. I'm assuming you have a ton of photos of past [properties / projects] sitting on your phone or website, right? [⏸️]

lines.label: Bucket 2: Do photos sit there
lines.raw: What happens to those right now—do they mostly just sit there [🤔]?

lines.label: Bucket 3: Inbound speed
lines.raw: [🐢] Now walk me through what happens the exact second a new inquiry comes in [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Bucket 3: Catching 8PM inquiries
lines.raw: Say a high-value client calls or messages while you're [on site / in a viewing] or at 8:00 PM [⬇️]. Who catches that, and how long does it usually take before they're qualified and booked onto your calendar [🤔]?

lines.label: Bucket 3: Tire-kickers
lines.raw: [🤔] Wait, tell me more about that... [⏸️] How many inquiries a week do you think end up being tire-kickers who don't actually have the budget, where you've already wasted time calling them back or driving out [🤔]?

lines.label: Bucket 4: Annoying admin
lines.raw: Got it [⬇️]. And once a client is in the pipeline—what's the most annoying, repetitive computer work or admin you or the team have to do every week [🤔]?

lines.label: Bucket 4: Review loop
lines.raw: Last piece of the puzzle [⬇️]. After you finish a job, how do you currently get them to leave a Google review [🤔]? Is that automated, or do people usually just forget?

lines.label: Trade work not bottleneck
lines.raw: [🐢] Okay, I've got a really clear picture of how the firm runs [⬇️]. [⏸️] Honestly, [Name], your actual work isn't the bottleneck at all [⬇️].

lines.label: Three specific leaks
lines.raw: Looking at your workflow from top to bottom, you have three specific operational leaks that are costing you serious time and money right now [⬇️]: [⏸️]

lines.label: Leak 1: Speed-to-lead
lines.raw: First is the Speed-to-Lead Leak [⬇️]. [⏸️] When high-value inquiries come in while you're busy, that delay before you can screen them is letting your best jobs slip to faster competitors [⬇️]—while you're still wasting time on low-budget tire-kickers [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Leak 2: Dormant assets
lines.raw: Second is the Dormant Asset Leak [⬇️]. [⏸️] You have great past projects and happy clients, but because nothing is automatically turning them into daily visibility and 5-star Google reviews, you're relying way too much on referrals [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Leak 3: Admin bleed
lines.raw: And third is the Evening Admin Bleed [⬇️]. [⏸️] You're personally losing [X] hours every week doing repetitive computer work like [insert their exact admin pain] [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: 15k on the table
lines.raw: [🐢] If you add those three up—missing just one or two good jobs a month plus losing [X] hours a week—you're easily leaving [100,000+ DKK / $15,000+] on the table every single month [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Diagnosis spot-on
lines.raw: Does that diagnosis feel spot-on to you [🤔]?

lines.label: Decision partner check
lines.raw: [🤔] Got it. Quick question before I go map this out—when you guys look at fixing operational bottlenecks like this, is that 100% your call, or do you have a business partner who weighs in too?

lines.label: Next steps & no generic PDFs
lines.raw: [⚡] Here is what we're going to do next [⬇️]. I don't like guessing on the spot, and I don't send generic PDF reports [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Custom AI architecture map
lines.raw: Tonight, I'm going to sit down with my engineering team, take the exact notes from how your firm runs, and map out a custom AI architecture specifically for [Company Name] that plugs all three of those leaks [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Working prototype promise
lines.raw: [🐢] Even better—instead of just talking about it in theory, I'm actually going to build out a live, working prototype customized to your business so you can test it with your own hands [⬇️].

lines.label: Lock the time
lines.raw: [⚡] It'll take me about 24 hours to put your custom build together [⬇️]. Are you in front of your computer tomorrow around 14:30, or is Thursday at 15:00 better [⬇️]?
